course.title: 雅思词汇真经
course.description: 图文刷词 · 打开即学

words.meaningZh: 矿泉水；苏打水（常用复数 表示）

words.definitionEn: A volcano is a mountain that can erupt lava and ash.
words.definitionZh: 能够喷发熔岩、火山灰和气体的山体。
words.note: 能够喷发熔岩、火山灰和气体的山体。
words.exampleEn: A volcanic eruption can force thousands of residents to leave their homes.
words.exampleZh: 火山喷发可能迫使数千名居民离开家园。

words.definitionEn: A glacier is a large mass of ice that moves slowly over land.
words.definitionZh: 缓慢移动的大型冰体。
words.note: 缓慢移动的大型冰体。
words.exampleEn: Many glaciers are retreating as global temperatures continue to rise.
words.exampleZh: 随着全球气温持续上升，许多冰川正在消退。

words.meaningZh: 三角洲；德耳塔（希腊字母的第四个字）
使恶化；使更严重 激怒

words.definitionEn: An ocean is a vast body of salt water.
words.definitionZh: 覆盖地球大部分表面的大片咸水。
words.note: 覆盖地球大部分表面的大片咸水。
words.exampleEn: Plastic waste poses a serious threat to life in the ocean.
words.exampleZh: 塑料垃圾对海洋生物构成严重威胁。

words.meaningZh: （海洋、湖泊等大水域的）岸；【文学】国家 （尤指濒海国家）（shores）
不可避免的；必然发生的 〈非正〉总会发生的
不可逆转的；不可挽回的
盘子；碟 金属牌 平板
采伐森林；清除…上的树林

words.definitionEn: The process by which green plants use light to make food.
words.definitionZh: 绿色植物利用光能制造食物的过程。
words.note: 绿色植物利用光能制造食物的过程。
words.exampleEn: Rising temperatures can reduce the rate of photosynthesis in some crop species.
words.exampleZh: 气温升高可能会降低某些农作物的光合作用速率。

words.definitionEn: To take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide through breathing.
words.definitionZh: 通过呼吸吸收氧气并释放二氧化碳。
words.note: 通过呼吸吸收氧气并释放二氧化碳。
words.exampleEn: Plants respire throughout the day and night, even when there is no sunlight.
words.exampleZh: 植物昼夜都在进行呼吸，即使没有阳光也是如此。

words.definitionEn: A compound containing two oxygen atoms joined to another element.
words.definitionZh: 含有两个氧原子并与另一元素结合的化合物。
words.note: 含有两个氧原子并与另一元素结合的化合物。
words.exampleEn: Carbon dioxide emissions must fall if countries are to meet their climate targets.
words.exampleZh: 如果各国要实现气候目标，就必须减少二氧化碳排放。

words.definitionEn: Plants growing in a particular place or area.
words.definitionZh: 某地生长的植物总称。
words.note: 某地生长的植物总称。
words.exampleEn: Dense vegetation helps prevent soil from being washed away during heavy rain.
words.exampleZh: 茂密的植被有助于防止土壤在暴雨中被冲走。

words.definitionEn: A small plant whose leaves or seeds are used for food or medicine.
words.definitionZh: 叶或种子可用于食物或药物的小型植物。
words.note: 叶或种子可用于食物或药物的小型植物。
words.exampleEn: Many traditional medicines are made from locally grown herbs.
words.exampleZh: 许多传统药物由当地种植的草药制成。

words.definitionEn: A plant that lives and grows for more than two years.
words.definitionZh: 寿命超过两年的多年生植物。
words.note: 寿命超过两年的多年生植物。
words.exampleEn: Perennial crops can protect the soil because they do not need to be replanted every year.
words.exampleZh: 多年生作物无需每年重新种植，因此可以保护土壤。

words.definitionEn: The scientific study of plants.
words.definitionZh: 研究植物的科学。
words.note: 研究植物的科学。
words.exampleEn: Advances in botany have helped scientists develop crops that tolerate drought.
words.exampleZh: 植物学的进步帮助科学家培育出了耐旱作物。

words.definitionEn: The study of how living things interact with their environment.
words.definitionZh: 研究生物与环境相互作用的学科。
words.note: 研究生物与环境相互作用的学科。
words.exampleEn: The road project could have lasting effects on the ecology of the region.
words.exampleZh: 这项道路工程可能对该地区的生态产生长期影响。

words.definitionEn: A community of organisms and the environment they live in.
words.definitionZh: 生物群落及其生存环境组成的系统。
words.note: 生物群落及其生存环境组成的系统。
words.exampleEn: Removing one species can upset the balance of an entire ecosystem.
words.exampleZh: 移除一个物种可能会破坏整个生态系统的平衡。

words.meaningZh: 对生态环境友好的；不妨害生态环境的
words.definitionEn: Designed to cause little or no harm to the environment.
words.definitionZh: 对环境危害很小或没有危害的。
words.note: 对环境危害很小或没有危害的。
words.exampleEn: Consumers are increasingly willing to pay more for eco-friendly packaging.
words.exampleZh: 消费者越来越愿意为环保包装支付更高的价格。

words.definitionEn: The science and practice of growing fruits, vegetables, and flowers.
words.definitionZh: 种植水果、蔬菜和花卉的科学与实践。
words.note: 种植水果、蔬菜和花卉的科学与实践。
words.exampleEn: Urban horticulture can provide fresh food and create greener neighbourhoods.
words.exampleZh: 城市园艺既能提供新鲜食物，也能让社区更加绿色。

words.definitionEn: An individual living thing, such as a plant or animal.
words.definitionZh: 一个独立的生物体，如植物或动物。
words.note: 一个独立的生物体，如植物或动物。
words.exampleEn: Even a simple organism can respond to changes in its environment.
words.exampleZh: 即使是简单的生物体也能对环境变化作出反应。

words.definitionEn: The study of genes and how traits pass from parents to offspring.
words.definitionZh: 研究基因以及性状如何遗传的学科。
words.note: 研究基因以及性状如何遗传的学科。
words.exampleEn: Modern genetics allows researchers to identify inherited resistance to disease.
words.exampleZh: 现代遗传学使研究人员能够识别遗传性的抗病能力。

words.definitionEn: A change in the genetic material of a living thing.
words.definitionZh: 生物遗传物质发生的改变。
words.note: 生物遗传物质发生的改变。
words.exampleEn: A genetic mutation may help a species survive in a changing environment.
words.exampleZh: 基因突变可能帮助一个物种在变化的环境中生存。

words.definitionEn: A difference or change in form, quality, or amount.
words.definitionZh: 形式、性质或数量上的差异或变化。
words.note: 形式、性质或数量上的差异或变化。
words.exampleEn: There is considerable variation in rainfall between the northern and southern regions.
words.exampleZh: 南北地区的降雨量存在显著差异。

words.definitionEn: The variety of different living things or types in a group.
words.definitionZh: 群体中不同生物或类型的多样性。
words.note: 群体中不同生物或类型的多样性。
words.exampleEn: Greater crop diversity can make food systems more resilient to climate change.
words.exampleZh: 提高作物多样性可以增强粮食系统应对气候变化的能力。

words.definitionEn: The process of producing offspring from different varieties or species.
words.definitionZh: 不同品种或物种产生后代的过程。
words.note: 不同品种或物种产生后代的过程。
words.exampleEn: Hybridisation is often used to combine useful traits from two plant varieties.
words.exampleZh: 杂交通常用于结合两个植物品种的有利性状。

words.definitionEn: To arrange things into groups according to shared features.
words.definitionZh: 按照共同特征把事物分组。
words.note: 按照共同特征把事物分组。
words.exampleEn: Researchers classify plants according to their shared physical and genetic features.
words.exampleZh: 研究人员根据共同的形态和遗传特征对植物进行分类。

words.definitionEn: To produce new plants, animals, or other living things.
words.definitionZh: 产生新的植物、动物或其他生物。
words.note: 产生新的植物、动物或其他生物。
words.exampleEn: Some plants can reproduce without producing seeds.
words.exampleZh: 有些植物无需产生种子也能繁殖。

words.definitionEn: To change gradually over generations and become better adapted.
words.definitionZh: 经过世代逐渐改变并更好地适应环境。
words.note: 经过世代逐渐改变并更好地适应环境。
words.exampleEn: Species may evolve new characteristics when environmental pressures persist for generations.
words.exampleZh: 当环境压力持续数代时，物种可能会进化出新的特征。

words.definitionEn: To rise and fall irregularly over time.
words.definitionZh: 随时间不规则地上下波动。
words.note: 随时间不规则地上下波动。
words.exampleEn: Food prices tend to fluctuate when harvests are affected by extreme weather.
words.exampleZh: 当收成受到极端天气影响时，食品价格往往会波动。

words.definitionEn: To make damaged or unused land useful again.
words.definitionZh: 使受损或闲置土地重新变得有用。
words.note: 使受损或闲置土地重新变得有用。
words.exampleEn: Several coastal cities have reclaimed land from the sea to support urban growth.
words.exampleZh: 一些沿海城市通过填海造地来支持城市发展。

words.meaningZh: 耕作；种植 陶冶思想 培养(友谊)
words.definitionEn: To prepare land and grow plants, or develop something carefully.
words.definitionZh: 整地种植，或用心发展某事物。
words.note: 整地种植，或用心发展某事物。
words.exampleEn: Farmers in dry regions cultivate crops that require relatively little water.
words.exampleZh: 干旱地区的农民种植需水量相对较少的作物。

words.definitionEn: To plant seeds in soil.
words.definitionZh: 把种子播入土壤。
words.note: 把种子播入土壤。
words.exampleEn: Farmers usually sow these seeds at the beginning of the rainy season.
words.exampleZh: 农民通常在雨季开始时播下这些种子。

words.definitionEn: The gathering of a crop, or the crop gathered.
words.definitionZh: 收集作物，或指收集到的作物。
words.note: 收集作物，或指收集到的作物。
words.exampleEn: A severe drought reduced the wheat harvest by almost a third.
words.exampleZh: 严重干旱使小麦收成减少了近三分之一。

words.definitionEn: To pull or pick something, especially a flower or fruit.
words.definitionZh: 拉下或采摘某物，尤其是花或果实。
words.note: 拉下或采摘某物，尤其是花或果实。
words.exampleEn: Workers must pluck the tea leaves by hand to avoid damaging them.
words.exampleZh: 工人必须手工采摘茶叶，以免将其损坏。

words.definitionEn: To choose or remove something by hand.
words.definitionZh: 用手挑选或摘取某物。
words.note: 用手挑选或摘取某物。
words.exampleEn: Seasonal workers are employed to pick fruit during the summer months.
words.exampleZh: 夏季会雇用季节性工人采摘水果。

words.definitionEn: The amount produced by a crop, or to produce a result.
words.definitionZh: 作物的产量，或产生某种结果。
words.note: 作物的产量，或产生某种结果。
words.exampleEn: Improved irrigation has increased crop yields without expanding farmland.
words.exampleZh: 改进灌溉在不扩大农田的情况下提高了作物产量。

words.definitionEn: To raise and care for a child or an animal.
words.definitionZh: 养育并照料孩子或动物。
words.note: 养育并照料孩子或动物。
words.exampleEn: Many rural families rear livestock as an additional source of income.
words.exampleZh: 许多农村家庭饲养牲畜作为额外的收入来源。

words.definitionEn: Suitable for growing crops.
words.definitionZh: 适合耕种作物的。
words.note: 适合耕种作物的。
words.exampleEn: Rapid urban expansion is reducing the amount of arable land near major cities.
words.exampleZh: 城市快速扩张正在减少大城市周边的可耕地面积。

words.definitionEn: A farm tool, or to turn over soil with it.
words.definitionZh: 用于翻土的农具，或用它翻土。
words.note: 用于翻土的农具，或用它翻土。
words.exampleEn: Some farmers plough the soil less frequently in order to reduce erosion.
words.exampleZh: 一些农民减少翻耕土壤的频率，以减轻土壤侵蚀。

words.definitionEn: A tool with a broad blade used for digging soil.
words.definitionZh: 用于挖土、带宽刃的工具。
words.note: 用于挖土、带宽刃的工具。
words.exampleEn: A spade is more suitable than heavy machinery for work in a small garden.
words.exampleZh: 在小型花园中作业时，铁锹比重型机械更合适。

words.definitionEn: A tool with teeth used to gather leaves or level soil.
words.definitionZh: 带齿、用于聚拢落叶或平整土壤的工具。
words.note: 带齿、用于聚拢落叶或平整土壤的工具。
words.exampleEn: Volunteers used a rake to remove dead leaves from the community garden.
words.exampleZh: 志愿者用耙子清理社区花园里的枯叶。

words.definitionEn: A neat pile of things placed one on top of another.
words.definitionZh: 整齐地一层层堆放的东西。
words.note: 整齐地一层层堆放的东西。
words.exampleEn: The wood was left in a stack so that it could dry before winter.
words.exampleZh: 木材被堆放起来，以便在冬季到来前晾干。

words.definitionEn: A large untidy pile of things.
words.definitionZh: 杂乱的一大堆东西。
words.note: 杂乱的一大堆东西。
words.exampleEn: Food scraps can be added to a compost heap instead of being sent to landfill.
words.exampleZh: 食物残渣可以放进堆肥堆，而不必送往垃圾填埋场。

words.definitionEn: A group of things tied or wrapped together.
words.definitionZh: 捆扎或包在一起的一组东西。
words.note: 捆扎或包在一起的一组东西。
words.exampleEn: Each bundle of reeds was dried before being used for roofing.
words.exampleZh: 每捆芦苇在用于铺设屋顶之前都经过了晾晒。

words.definitionEn: A group of similar things growing or held together.
words.definitionZh: 生长或聚在一起的一组相似事物。
words.note: 生长或聚在一起的一组相似事物。
words.exampleEn: A bunch of bananas requires a warm climate and a reliable water supply.
words.exampleZh: 一串香蕉的生长需要温暖的气候和稳定的水源。

words.definitionEn: A container used for holding flowers.
words.definitionZh: 用来插花的容器。
words.note: 用来插花的容器。
words.exampleEn: Cut flowers usually last longer when clean water is added to the vase each day.
words.exampleZh: 如果每天给花瓶换上清水，鲜切花通常能保存得更久。

words.definitionEn: Light that comes from the sun.
words.definitionZh: 来自太阳的光。
words.note: 来自太阳的光。
words.exampleEn: The panels convert sunlight into electricity for nearby homes.
words.exampleZh: 这些面板将阳光转化为电力，供附近家庭使用。

words.definitionEn: An organism such as a mushroom or mould that feeds on organic matter.
words.definitionZh: 靠有机物为生的生物，如蘑菇或霉菌。
words.note: 靠有机物为生的生物，如蘑菇或霉菌。
words.exampleEn: The fungus spreads rapidly when the soil remains warm and damp.
words.exampleZh: 当土壤保持温暖潮湿时，这种真菌会迅速蔓延。

words.definitionEn: A fungus that grows as a soft, fuzzy coating on damp materials.
words.definitionZh: 在潮湿材料上形成柔软绒状层的真菌。
words.note: 在潮湿材料上形成柔软绒状层的真菌。
words.exampleEn: Poor ventilation encourages mould to grow on damp walls.
words.exampleZh: 通风不良会促使霉菌在潮湿的墙面上生长。

words.definitionEn: The fine powder made by flowers for plant reproduction.
words.definitionZh: 花为繁殖产生的细小粉末。
words.note: 花为繁殖产生的细小粉末。
words.exampleEn: Bees carry pollen from one flower to another as they search for food.
words.exampleZh: 蜜蜂觅食时会把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花。

words.definitionEn: To begin growing from a seed.
words.definitionZh: 种子开始生长。
words.note: 种子开始生长。
words.exampleEn: The seeds will not germinate unless the soil is sufficiently warm.
words.exampleZh: 除非土壤足够温暖，否则这些种子不会发芽。

words.definitionEn: The part of a plant that can grow into a new plant.
words.definitionZh: 能长成新植物的植物部分。
words.note: 能长成新植物的植物部分。
words.exampleEn: A seed can remain inactive in the soil until conditions become suitable for growth.
words.exampleZh: 种子可以在土壤中保持休眠，直到生长条件适宜。

words.definitionEn: To begin to grow or develop rapidly.
words.definitionZh: 开始生长或迅速发展。
words.note: 开始生长或迅速发展。
words.exampleEn: Interest in community gardening has burgeoned in many large cities.
words.exampleZh: 许多大城市对社区园艺的兴趣迅速增长。

words.definitionEn: A young, unopened flower or leaf.
words.definitionZh: 尚未开放的花或叶。
words.note: 尚未开放的花或叶。
words.exampleEn: Each bud develops into a flower when temperatures rise in spring.
words.exampleZh: 春天气温升高时，每个花蕾都会发育成花朵。

words.definitionEn: The coloured part of a plant that produces seeds.
words.definitionZh: 植物产生种子的有色部分。
words.note: 植物产生种子的有色部分。
words.exampleEn: The plant produces a white flower that attracts insects at night.
words.exampleZh: 这种植物会开出白色花朵，在夜间吸引昆虫。

words.definitionEn: A flower, especially one on a fruit tree.
words.definitionZh: 花，尤其是果树上的花。
words.note: 花，尤其是果树上的花。
words.exampleEn: Fruit production may fall if frost damages the blossom in early spring.
words.exampleZh: 如果早春的霜冻损害花朵，水果产量可能会下降。

words.definitionEn: A flower, or to produce flowers.
words.definitionZh: 花朵，或开花。
words.note: 花朵，或开花。
words.exampleEn: The desert can bloom for a short period after unusually heavy rain.
words.exampleZh: 在异常充沛的降雨过后，沙漠可能会短暂地繁花盛开。

words.definitionEn: A smell, especially a pleasant one.
words.definitionZh: 气味，尤其是令人愉快的气味。
words.note: 气味，尤其是令人愉快的气味。
words.exampleEn: The strong scent of the flowers attracts insects from a considerable distance.
words.exampleZh: 花朵浓郁的香味能从相当远的地方吸引昆虫。

words.definitionEn: Having a noticeable and usually pleasant smell.
words.definitionZh: 有明显且通常令人愉快的气味。
words.note: 有明显且通常令人愉快的气味。
words.exampleEn: Aromatic plants are widely used in food, medicine, and cosmetics.
words.exampleZh: 芳香植物被广泛用于食品、药品和化妆品中。

words.definitionEn: To become fully grown and ready to eat.
words.definitionZh: 成熟并达到可食用状态。
words.note: 成熟并达到可食用状态。
words.exampleEn: Warmer summers allow some fruits to ripen earlier than they did in the past.
words.exampleZh: 更温暖的夏季使一些水果比过去更早成熟。

words.definitionEn: The part of a plant that develops from a flower and contains seeds.
words.definitionZh: 由花发育而来、含有种子的植物部分。
words.note: 由花发育而来、含有种子的植物部分。
words.exampleEn: The tree begins to bear fruit approximately three years after planting.
words.exampleZh: 这种树在种植大约三年后开始结果。

words.definitionEn: To become dry, weak, and unable to grow.
words.definitionZh: 变得干枯、衰弱并无法继续生长。
words.note: 变得干枯、衰弱并无法继续生长。
words.exampleEn: Young plants quickly wither when they are exposed to prolonged drought.
words.exampleZh: 幼苗在遭遇长期干旱时会迅速枯萎。

words.definitionEn: To break down naturally into simpler substances.
words.definitionZh: 自然分解成更简单的物质。
words.note: 自然分解成更简单的物质。
words.exampleEn: Organic waste decomposes more quickly in warm, moist conditions.
words.exampleZh: 有机废弃物在温暖潮湿的条件下分解得更快。

words.definitionEn: To decay and become damaged or unusable.
words.definitionZh: 腐烂并变得损坏或无法使用。
words.note: 腐烂并变得损坏或无法使用。
words.exampleEn: Stored crops may rot if the building is damp or poorly ventilated.
words.exampleZh: 如果储存建筑潮湿或通风不良，农作物可能会腐烂。

words.definitionEn: The gradual breakdown or loss of strength and condition.
words.definitionZh: 状态逐渐分解、衰退或失去力量。
words.note: 状态逐渐分解、衰退或失去力量。
words.exampleEn: Fallen leaves decay and return valuable nutrients to the soil.
words.exampleZh: 落叶腐烂后会把宝贵的养分归还土壤。

words.definitionEn: No longer fresh, usually because it has been kept too long.
words.definitionZh: 因放置太久而不再新鲜。
words.note: 因放置太久而不再新鲜。
words.exampleEn: Large quantities of bread are discarded simply because they have become stale.
words.exampleZh: 大量面包仅仅因为变得不新鲜就被丢弃。

words.definitionEn: A dense forest with high rainfall, usually in a tropical region.
words.definitionZh: 降雨量高、通常位于热带的茂密森林。
words.note: 降雨量高、通常位于热带的茂密森林。
words.exampleEn: Tropical rainforests store vast amounts of carbon and support exceptional biodiversity.
words.exampleZh: 热带雨林储存着大量碳，并维系着极高的生物多样性。

words.definitionEn: A thick tropical forest with dense vegetation.
words.definitionZh: 植被浓密的热带森林。
words.note: 植被浓密的热带森林。
words.exampleEn: Building roads through the jungle can divide wildlife habitats into isolated areas.
words.exampleZh: 在丛林中修路会把野生动物栖息地分割成彼此孤立的区域。

words.definitionEn: A large farm where one crop is grown commercially.
words.definitionZh: 大面积商业种植单一作物的农场。
words.note: 大面积商业种植单一作物的农场。
words.exampleEn: The former forest was cleared to make way for a palm oil plantation.
words.exampleZh: 原有森林被砍伐，以便建设棕榈油种植园。

words.definitionEn: An area of open land, especially one used for crops.
words.definitionZh: 开阔土地，尤其是用于种植作物的土地。
words.note: 开阔土地，尤其是用于种植作物的土地。
words.exampleEn: The field is left unused every few years to allow the soil to recover.
words.exampleZh: 这块田地每隔几年会休耕，以便土壤恢复。

words.definitionEn: A level strip of land cut into a slope for farming.
words.definitionZh: 在坡地上开出的用于耕种的水平地带。
words.note: 在坡地上开出的用于耕种的水平地带。
words.exampleEn: Farmers built each terrace to retain water on the steep hillside.
words.exampleZh: 农民修建层层梯田，以便在陡峭山坡上蓄水。

words.definitionEn: Wood prepared for building or other practical uses.
words.definitionZh: 用于建筑或其他实用用途的木材。
words.note: 用于建筑或其他实用用途的木材。
words.exampleEn: Illegal demand for timber is a major cause of forest loss in the region.
words.exampleZh: 对木材的非法需求是该地区森林减少的主要原因。

words.definitionEn: A black fuel made by heating wood without much oxygen.
words.definitionZh: 在缺氧条件下加热木材制成的黑色燃料。
words.note: 在缺氧条件下加热木材制成的黑色燃料。
words.exampleEn: Charcoal production can contribute to deforestation when trees are not replanted.
words.exampleZh: 如果不补种树木，木炭生产可能会加剧森林砍伐。

words.definitionEn: A thick piece of a tree trunk, usually cut for fuel or timber.
words.definitionZh: 通常用作燃料或木材的粗大树干段。
words.note: 通常用作燃料或木材的粗大树干段。
words.exampleEn: Scientists examined each fallen log as a habitat for insects and fungi.
words.exampleZh: 科学家把每根倒下的原木都作为昆虫和真菌的栖息地进行研究。

words.definitionEn: A symbol or design used to identify a company or organisation.
words.definitionZh: 用于识别公司或组织的符号或图案。
words.note: 用于识别公司或组织的符号或图案。
words.exampleEn: A recognisable logo can help consumers distinguish one brand from another.
words.exampleZh: 容易识别的标志可以帮助消费者区分不同品牌。

words.definitionEn: The science and work of managing forests and woodland.
words.definitionZh: 管理森林和林地的科学与工作。
words.note: 管理森林和林地的科学与工作。
words.exampleEn: Sustainable forestry aims to meet demand for wood without destroying forest ecosystems.
words.exampleZh: 可持续林业旨在满足木材需求，同时不破坏森林生态系统。

words.definitionEn: A part of a tree that grows out from the trunk.
words.definitionZh: 从树干向外生长的部分。
words.note: 从树干向外生长的部分。
words.exampleEn: The weight of the snow caused a large branch to break from the tree.
words.exampleZh: 积雪的重量导致一根大树枝从树上折断。

words.definitionEn: The main thick stem of a tree.
words.definitionZh: 树的主要粗大茎干。
words.note: 树的主要粗大茎干。
words.exampleEn: The rings inside a tree trunk can provide evidence of past climate conditions.
words.exampleZh: 树干内部的年轮可以提供过去气候状况的证据。

words.definitionEn: A large main branch of a tree.
words.definitionZh: 树的大主枝。
words.note: 树的大主枝。
words.exampleEn: Several birds built their nests on a broad bough above the river.
words.exampleZh: 几只鸟把巢筑在河流上方的一根粗大树枝上。

words.definitionEn: The part of a plant that anchors it and takes in water.
words.definitionZh: 固定植物并吸收水分的部分。
words.note: 固定植物并吸收水分的部分。
words.exampleEn: Deep roots enable the plant to reach water far below the surface.
words.exampleZh: 深根使植物能够吸收到地表以下很深处的水分。

words.definitionEn: Grass cut and dried for animal feed.
words.definitionZh: 割下并晒干、用于喂养动物的草。
words.note: 割下并晒干、用于喂养动物的草。
words.exampleEn: Farmers store hay during the summer to feed cattle in winter.
words.exampleZh: 农民在夏季储存干草，以便冬季喂牛。

words.definitionEn: Dry stalks left after grain has been harvested.
words.definitionZh: 谷物收割后留下的干燥茎秆。
words.note: 谷物收割后留下的干燥茎秆。
words.exampleEn: Rice straw can be reused as animal bedding or converted into fuel.
words.exampleZh: 稻草可以重新用作动物垫料，也可以转化为燃料。

words.definitionEn: A tall, thin water plant with a hollow stem.
words.definitionZh: 茎秆细长中空、通常生长在水边的植物。
words.note: 茎秆细长中空、通常生长在水边的植物。
words.exampleEn: Dense beds of reeds provide shelter for fish and nesting birds.
words.exampleZh: 茂密的芦苇丛为鱼类和筑巢鸟类提供庇护。

words.definitionEn: A sharp point growing on the stem of some plants.
words.definitionZh: 某些植物茎上生长的尖刺。
words.note: 某些植物茎上生长的尖刺。
words.exampleEn: The plant has a sharp thorn that protects it from grazing animals.
words.exampleZh: 这种植物长有尖刺，可以保护自己不被食草动物啃食。

words.definitionEn: A wild plant growing where it is not wanted.
words.definitionZh: 生长在不希望位置的野生植物。
words.note: 生长在不希望位置的野生植物。
words.exampleEn: A weed competes with crops for water, light, and soil nutrients.
words.exampleZh: 杂草会与作物争夺水分、光照和土壤养分。

words.definitionEn: A common plant with narrow green leaves and no woody stem.
words.definitionZh: 叶片狭长、没有木质茎的常见植物。
words.note: 叶片狭长、没有木质茎的常见植物。
words.exampleEn: Native grass helps stabilise the soil in areas affected by erosion.
words.exampleZh: 本地草种有助于稳定受侵蚀地区的土壤。

words.definitionEn: A field covered mainly with grass and wild flowers.
words.definitionZh: 主要长有草和野花的田地。
words.note: 主要长有草和野花的田地。
words.exampleEn: The meadow supports a wide variety of insects during the summer.
words.exampleZh: 这片草地在夏季为多种昆虫提供生存环境。

words.definitionEn: An area of short, regularly cut grass.
words.definitionZh: 经常修剪的短草地。
words.note: 经常修剪的短草地。
words.exampleEn: Replacing a lawn with native plants can reduce household water use.
words.exampleZh: 用本地植物替代草坪可以减少家庭用水。

words.definitionEn: A small green or black fruit used for oil and food.
words.definitionZh: 可榨油食用的绿色或黑色小果实。
words.note: 可榨油食用的绿色或黑色小果实。
words.exampleEn: Olive trees are well adapted to hot summers and limited rainfall.
words.exampleZh: 橄榄树非常适应炎热的夏季和有限的降雨。

words.meaningZh: 松树 松木；vi. 消瘦
words.definitionEn: An evergreen tree with needle-like leaves and cones.
words.definitionZh: 叶子呈针状、结球果的常绿树。
words.note: 叶子呈针状、结球果的常绿树。
words.exampleEn: Pine forests are increasingly threatened by drought, fire, and insect damage.
words.exampleZh: 松林正日益受到干旱、火灾和虫害的威胁。

words.definitionEn: A climbing or trailing plant with a long, thin stem.
words.definitionZh: 茎细长、攀爬或匍匐生长的植物。
words.note: 茎细长、攀爬或匍匐生长的植物。
words.exampleEn: The vine grows along a support so that its leaves can receive more light.
words.exampleZh: 藤蔓沿着支架生长，使叶片能够获得更多光照。

words.definitionEn: A small purple flower, or a purple-blue colour.
words.definitionZh: 一种小型紫色花，也指紫蓝色。
words.note: 一种小型紫色花，也指紫蓝色。
words.exampleEn: The wild violet tends to grow in cool, shaded woodland.
words.exampleZh: 野生紫罗兰往往生长在凉爽、背阴的林地中。

words.definitionEn: A spring flower that grows from a bulb.
words.definitionZh: 由球根生长的春季花卉。
words.note: 由球根生长的春季花卉。
words.exampleEn: Tulip bulbs require a period of cold weather before they begin to grow.
words.exampleZh: 郁金香球茎需要经历一段寒冷天气才会开始生长。

words.definitionEn: A plant with a fresh smell and flavour used in food and drinks.
words.definitionZh: 有清新气味和味道、用于食物饮料的植物。
words.note: 有清新气味和味道、用于食物饮料的植物。
words.exampleEn: Mint spreads rapidly and may take over a garden if it is not controlled.
words.exampleZh: 薄荷蔓延得很快，如果不加控制，可能会占满整个花园。

words.definitionEn: A ridge of rock or coral near the surface of the sea.
words.definitionZh: 靠近海面的一道岩石或珊瑚脊。
words.note: 靠近海面的一道岩石或珊瑚脊。
words.exampleEn: Rising sea temperatures are causing serious damage to coral reefs.
words.exampleZh: 海水温度上升正在对珊瑚礁造成严重破坏。

words.definitionEn: A simple plant-like organism that grows in water.
words.definitionZh: 生长在水中的简单植物样生物。
words.note: 生长在水中的简单植物样生物。
words.exampleEn: This alga grows rapidly when excess nutrients enter the lake.
words.exampleZh: 当过量养分进入湖泊时，这种藻会迅速生长。

words.definitionEn: A protein that speeds up a chemical reaction in a living thing.
words.definitionZh: 能加快生物体内化学反应的蛋白质。
words.note: 能加快生物体内化学反应的蛋白质。
words.exampleEn: The enzyme breaks complex molecules down into simpler substances.
words.exampleZh: 这种酶会把复杂分子分解成更简单的物质。

words.definitionEn: A substance that makes a chemical reaction happen faster.
words.definitionZh: 能使化学反应加快的物质。
words.note: 能使化学反应加快的物质。
words.exampleEn: Public investment can act as a catalyst for the development of clean technology.
words.exampleZh: 公共投资可以成为清洁技术发展的催化剂。

words.definitionEn: To let a substance, person, or object go free.
words.definitionZh: 使物质、人或物体释放或离开。
words.note: 使物质、人或物体释放或离开。
words.exampleEn: Burning fossil fuels releases large quantities of carbon into the atmosphere.
words.exampleZh: 燃烧化石燃料会向大气中释放大量碳。

words.definitionEn: The release of gas, heat, light, or other matter.
words.definitionZh: 气体、热量、光或其他物质的释放。
words.note: 气体、热量、光或其他物质的释放。
words.exampleEn: Transport is one of the largest sources of greenhouse gas emissions in cities.
words.exampleZh: 交通是城市温室气体排放的最大来源之一。

words.definitionEn: To take in a liquid, gas, or energy.
words.definitionZh: 吸收液体、气体或能量。
words.note: 吸收液体、气体或能量。
words.exampleEn: Forests absorb carbon dioxide and help regulate the global climate.
words.exampleZh: 森林吸收二氧化碳，并有助于调节全球气候。

words.definitionEn: The movement of blood, air, water, or information around a system.
words.definitionZh: 血液、空气、水或信息在系统中的流动。
words.note: 血液、空气、水或信息在系统中的流动。
words.exampleEn: Ocean circulation distributes heat around the planet.
words.exampleZh: 海洋环流把热量输送到地球各处。

words.definitionEn: To be greater than a limit, amount, or expectation.
words.definitionZh: 超过某个限度、数量或预期。
words.note: 超过某个限度、数量或预期。
words.exampleEn: Demand for fresh water may soon exceed the available supply.
words.exampleZh: 淡水需求可能很快会超过现有供应量。

words.definitionEn: The process of taking in or absorbing something.
words.definitionZh: 摄取或吸收某物的过程。
words.note: 摄取或吸收某物的过程。
words.exampleEn: Adequate moisture is essential for the uptake of nutrients by plant roots.
words.exampleZh: 充足的水分对植物根系吸收养分至关重要。

words.definitionEn: A substance needed by a living thing to grow and stay healthy.
words.definitionZh: 生物生长和保持健康所需的物质。
words.note: 生物生长和保持健康所需的物质。
words.exampleEn: Nitrogen is an essential nutrient for healthy plant growth.
words.exampleZh: 氮是植物健康生长所必需的养分。

words.definitionEn: The power needed to do work or cause change.
words.definitionZh: 做功或引起变化所需的力量。
words.note: 做功或引起变化所需的力量。
words.exampleEn: Renewable energy can reduce dependence on imported fossil fuels.
words.exampleZh: 可再生能源可以减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

words.definitionEn: The things and conditions around a person or place.
words.definitionZh: 某人或某地周围的事物和条件。
words.note: 某人或某地周围的事物和条件。
words.exampleEn: Access to green surroundings can improve the well-being of urban residents.
words.exampleZh: 接触绿色环境可以改善城市居民的身心健康。

words.definitionEn: A system of parts or processes that produces a result.
words.definitionZh: 由部件或过程组成、能够产生结果的系统。
words.note: 由部件或过程组成、能够产生结果的系统。
words.exampleEn: The exact mechanism by which the plant resists disease is still unknown.
words.exampleZh: 这种植物抵抗疾病的确切机制仍不清楚。

words.definitionEn: To balance or reduce the effect of something else.
words.definitionZh: 抵消或减弱另一事物的影响。
words.note: 抵消或减弱另一事物的影响。
words.exampleEn: New woodland could counterbalance some of the carbon produced by the development.
words.exampleZh: 新建林地可以抵消该开发项目产生的部分碳排放。

words.definitionEn: To keep someone or something safe from harm.
words.definitionZh: 使某人或某物免受伤害。
words.note: 使某人或某物免受伤害。
words.exampleEn: Strict regulations are needed to protect wetlands from further development.
words.exampleZh: 需要严格的法规来保护湿地，防止其被进一步开发。

words.definitionEn: To keep something safe, unchanged, or in good condition.
words.definitionZh: 使某物安全、保持原状或良好状态。
words.note: 使某物安全、保持原状或良好状态。
words.exampleEn: Seed banks preserve genetic material that may be valuable in the future.
words.exampleZh: 种子库保存可能在未来具有价值的遗传材料。

words.definitionEn: The careful protection and management of nature and resources.
words.definitionZh: 谨慎保护和管理自然及资源。
words.note: 谨慎保护和管理自然及资源。
words.exampleEn: Successful conservation depends on the support of local communities.
words.exampleZh: 成功的自然保护有赖于当地社区的支持。

words.meaningZh: 使熄灭；扑灭 使…不复存在
words.definitionEn: To put out a fire or stop something completely.
words.definitionZh: 扑灭火焰或彻底停止某事。
words.note: 扑灭火焰或彻底停止某事。
words.exampleEn: Firefighters struggled to extinguish the forest fire in strong winds.
words.exampleZh: 消防员在强风中奋力扑灭森林火灾。

words.definitionEn: To destroy or cause serious damage.
words.definitionZh: 摧毁或造成严重损害。
words.note: 摧毁或造成严重损害。
words.exampleEn: In programming, an object may destruct when it is no longer required by the system.
words.exampleZh: 在程序设计中，当系统不再需要某个对象时，它可能会被析构。

words.definitionEn: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used or repaired.
words.definitionZh: 严重损坏到无法使用或修复。
words.note: 严重损坏到无法使用或修复。
words.exampleEn: Uncontrolled tourism can ruin the natural character of a coastal area.
words.exampleZh: 不受控制的旅游业可能会破坏沿海地区的自然风貌。

words.definitionEn: To die or be destroyed, especially gradually or violently.
words.definitionZh: 死亡或被毁灭。
words.note: 死亡或被毁灭。
words.exampleEn: Many young plants perish during prolonged periods of extreme heat.
words.exampleZh: 许多幼苗会在持续的极端高温中死亡。

words.definitionEn: To pull down or destroy a building or structure.
words.definitionZh: 拆毁建筑物或结构。
words.note: 拆毁建筑物或结构。
words.exampleEn: The council plans to demolish the unsafe buildings and create a public park.
words.exampleZh: 市政委员会计划拆除这些不安全的建筑，并修建一座公共公园。

words.definitionEn: To break a law, rule, or someone's rights.
words.definitionZh: 违反法律、规则或他人的权利。
words.note: 违反法律、规则或他人的权利。
words.exampleEn: Environmental policies should not infringe the basic rights of local communities.
words.exampleZh: 环境政策不应侵犯当地社区的基本权利。

words.meaningZh: 在某物下挖洞或挖通道；侵蚀…的基础 暗中破坏
words.definitionEn: To weaken something gradually or secretly.
words.definitionZh: 逐渐或暗中削弱某事物。
words.note: 逐渐或暗中削弱某事物。
words.exampleEn: Illegal logging can undermine years of forest conservation work.
words.exampleZh: 非法采伐可能会破坏多年的森林保护成果。

words.definitionEn: The complete disappearance of a species or group.
words.definitionZh: 某个物种或群体完全消失。
words.note: 某个物种或群体完全消失。
words.exampleEn: Habitat loss remains the leading cause of species extinction.
words.exampleZh: 栖息地丧失仍然是物种灭绝的首要原因。

words.definitionEn: A repeated or regular way in which something happens.
words.definitionZh: 某事发生的重复或规律方式。
words.note: 某事发生的重复或规律方式。
words.exampleEn: The data reveal a clear seasonal pattern in household energy use.
words.exampleZh: 数据显示，家庭能源使用呈现出明显的季节性规律。

words.definitionEn: The final result of an action, event, or process.
words.definitionZh: 行动、事件或过程的最终结果。
words.note: 行动、事件或过程的最终结果。
words.exampleEn: The outcome of the trial will influence future farming policy.
words.exampleZh: 这项试验的结果将影响未来的农业政策。

words.definitionEn: A strong effect or influence on something.
words.definitionZh: 对某物产生的强烈影响。
words.note: 对某物产生的强烈影响。
words.exampleEn: The long-term impact of intensive farming is difficult to measure.
words.exampleZh: 集约化农业的长期影响很难衡量。

words.definitionEn: Happening or changing according to the season.
words.definitionZh: 随季节发生或变化的。
words.note: 随季节发生或变化的。
words.exampleEn: Seasonal changes in rainfall affect both crop growth and water supplies.
words.exampleZh: 降雨的季节性变化会影响作物生长和水资源供应。

words.definitionEn: Based on tests or trials rather than established knowledge.
words.definitionZh: 基于测试或试验、尚未完全确立的。
words.note: 基于测试或试验、尚未完全确立的。
words.exampleEn: The experimental method produced encouraging results under controlled conditions.
words.exampleZh: 这种实验方法在受控条件下取得了令人鼓舞的结果。

words.definitionEn: Helpful, suitable, or likely to produce a good result.
words.definitionZh: 有帮助、合适或可能带来好结果的。
words.note: 有帮助、合适或可能带来好结果的。
words.exampleEn: Warm soil and regular rainfall provide favourable conditions for growth.
words.exampleZh: 温暖的土壤和规律的降雨为生长提供了有利条件。

words.meaningZh: 多产的；富饶的 富有成效的
words.definitionEn: Producing a lot of useful results or goods.
words.definitionZh: 能产生大量有用成果或产品的。
words.note: 能产生大量有用成果或产品的。
words.exampleEn: Well-managed farmland can remain productive for many generations.
words.exampleZh: 管理得当的农田可以持续多代保持高产。

words.meaningZh: 有效的；生效的 事实上的
words.definitionEn: Successful in producing the intended result.
words.definitionZh: 能成功产生预期结果的。
words.note: 能成功产生预期结果的。
words.exampleEn: Public transport is an effective way to reduce urban air pollution.
words.exampleZh: 公共交通是减少城市空气污染的有效方式。

words.definitionEn: Working well without wasting time, energy, or resources.
words.definitionZh: 工作良好且不浪费时间、能量或资源的。
words.note: 工作良好且不浪费时间、能量或资源的。
words.exampleEn: Modern irrigation systems are more efficient in their use of water.
words.exampleZh: 现代灌溉系统的用水效率更高。

words.definitionEn: Large or important enough to be noticed or taken seriously.
words.definitionZh: 数量很大或重要到值得注意的。
words.note: 数量很大或重要到值得注意的。
words.exampleEn: Restoring the wetland would require considerable public investment.
words.exampleZh: 修复这片湿地需要大量公共投资。

words.definitionEn: Very large, heavy, or solid.
words.definitionZh: 非常大、重或坚实的。
words.note: 非常大、重或坚实的。
words.exampleEn: The storm caused massive damage to crops across the coastal region.
words.exampleZh: 这场风暴给沿海地区的农作物造成了巨大损失。

words.definitionEn: Extremely large or great.
words.definitionZh: 极其巨大或广大的。
words.note: 极其巨大或广大的。
words.exampleEn: The rainforest is of immense value to both wildlife and local people.
words.exampleZh: 这片雨林对野生动物和当地居民都具有极大价值。

words.definitionEn: As great or large as possible.
words.definitionZh: 达到可能的最大程度的。
words.note: 达到可能的最大程度的。
words.exampleEn: The plants reached maximal growth under warm and humid conditions.
words.exampleZh: 这些植物在温暖潮湿的条件下达到了最大生长量。

words.definitionEn: Very small or as little as possible.
words.definitionZh: 非常小或达到可能的最小程度的。
words.note: 非常小或达到可能的最小程度的。
words.exampleEn: The new farming technique causes minimal disturbance to the soil.
words.exampleZh: 这种新型耕作技术对土壤造成的扰动极小。

words.definitionEn: Best or most suitable for a particular purpose.
words.definitionZh: 针对特定目的最好的或最合适的。
words.note: 针对特定目的最好的或最合适的。
words.exampleEn: Seeds require an optimal balance of moisture, warmth, and oxygen to germinate.
words.exampleZh: 种子需要水分、温度和氧气达到最佳平衡才能发芽。
